b:
In the uproar
of hormones
two bodies
leap and throb

And in the mind,
love,
like an elephant in rut

Time too points the way
to the hour of union,
when every lovers' quarrel has vanished

In a full embrace
begins
that secret
man knows
and yet
does not know

Wherever lips
have touched,
drops of sweat
sprout

So that caresses
never run dry,

heaps of sound
in a vast silent space
become a coded language

In that space
where not even air
has room,
love alone
works for both parties

When even pretence is shed
the world is forgotten

As the five senses
sink into
the five organs,

time itself
goes missing
there
